name: vadimgaidai
description: A plan/implement/review workflow for TypeScript projects, plus optional React-UI and Feature-Sliced Design layers.

plugins.name: feature-workflow
plugins.description: Plan a unit of work into one PLAN.md, implement it in one pass, review the diff. Slices OpenAPI contracts so shapes are never guessed. Stack-agnostic — works in any TypeScript project.

plugins.name: react-shadcn-ui
plugins.description: React 19, shadcn/ui + Tailwind, TanStack Query and React Hook Form/Zod conventions, and a Figma-to-token theme sync agent. Add to any React project that uses shadcn.

plugins.name: feature-sliced-design
plugins.description: Feature-Sliced Design structure: layers, module anatomy, import direction, a deterministic scaffolder, and hooks that block misplaced files and naming violations.
